text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered for service `inference-canary` — sustained 5xx > 8% on canary pods in us-west1 during rollout. PD: https://pd.example.com/incidents/5990012345
sre-oncall (Zane): Acked. oncall taking this. pulling logs + checking canary node pool.
maya (prod-eng): I see repeated kv-cache OOMs and some `CUDNN_STATUS_EXECUTION_FAILED` entries in the canary runtime logs right after the feature flag flipped.
prateek (release-owner): rollout started at 13:02 UTC, flag `ff/new-token-cache` set to 100% for canary. Pausing rollout now.
pagerduty-bot: pager ack recorded (ack id: 599A-ack-77). escalation halted.
emily (prod-qa): customer reports from beta orgs show timeouts and 503s. Telemetry: response_time spikes > 30s for affected requests.
sre-oncall (Zane): quick surface triage: cluster-autoscaler didn't create extra pods. Found OOMKill on `inference-runtime` pods and GPU execution failures around the same timestamps.
prateek (release-owner): the flag increases persistent cache size from 2GB -> 6GB on start. could be memory pressure.
maya (prod-eng): confirmed — config drift: persistence.enabled was accidentally true for the canary, so memory ballooned on startup.
prateek (release-owner): rolling back canary traffic and disabling the flag. initiating rollback.
deploy-bot: Rollback requested by prateek: `rollback canary release v2.3.4-rc -> v2.3.3` (job id: rb-59900). ETA ~90s.
sre-oncall (Zane): while rollback runs I'll cordon the failing nodes and restart pods to clear GPU memory state. commands I'll run: ```kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-canary -n prod && kubectl delete pod -l app=inference-canary -n prod```
emily (prod-qa): setting incident severity to Sev2. Notifying customer-success for impacted beta customers now.
customer-success-bot: Notified account owners for orgs A, B, C. queued templated message.
prateek (release-owner): rollback job finished, canaries now on v2.3.3.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page resolved by prateek (auto-closed after rollback). Please confirm service health.
sre-oncall (Zane): monitoring p95/p99. 5xx rate dropped toward baseline within ~20s; p95 latency decreasing.
maya (prod-eng): verified logs on v2.3.3 — no OOMs after rollback. adding a guardrail: default `persistence.enabled=false` and a mem-check preflight in rollout pipeline.
prateek (release-owner): I'll open a PR to change the flag default and add an automated preflight that validates memory footprint on canary nodes.
emily (prod-qa): opening a follow-up ticket for postmortem and customer-impact assessment. tags: root_cause=config_drift+missing_preflight; mitigation=rollback+node_restarts.
sre-oncall (Zane): handing this for RCA follow-up to @maya. leaving notes here for the postmortem. any last items? :thumbsup:
maya (prod-eng): add a release-CLI guard: prevent enabling `persistence.enabled` without mem-limit override. i'll draft RFC and PR.
prateek (release-owner): apologizing for the disruption — will own the postmortem and the fix. thanks for the quick ack + rollback.
incident-bot: Incident thread closed for channel `eng-oncall`. Follow-up ticket: INC-59900 (postmortem assigned to prateek, assignee: maya).
